Here’s a table of the **top 10 holdings** of the **NASDAQ-100 Index (NDX)** as of **June 2024**, including their **market capitalization** and **P/E (Price-to-Earnings) ratio**. The data is based on the latest available information from sources like **Nasdaq Global Indexes, Yahoo Finance, and Bloomberg**.

| **Rank** | **Company**               | **Ticker** | **Sector**               | **Market Cap (USD)** | **P/E Ratio (TTM)** | **Weight in NDX (~)** |
|----------|---------------------------|------------|--------------------------|----------------------|---------------------|-----------------------|
| 1        | Microsoft                 | MSFT       | Technology (Software)    | ~$3.25T              | ~38.5               | ~12.5%                |
| 2        | Apple                     | AAPL       | Technology (Hardware)    | ~$3.15T              | ~30.1               | ~12.0%                |
| 3        | NVIDIA                    | NVDA       | Semiconductors           | ~$3.05T              | ~72.0               | ~11.8%                |
| 4        | Amazon                    | AMZN       | Consumer Discretionary   | ~$1.95T              | ~55.0               | ~7.5%                 |
| 5        | Meta (Facebook)           | META       | Communication Services   | ~$1.25T              | ~28.0               | ~5.0%                 |
| 6        | Alphabet (Google) Class A | GOOGL      | Communication Services   | ~$2.20T              | ~27.5               | ~4.8%                 |
| 7        | Alphabet (Google) Class C | GOOG       | Communication Services   | ~$2.20T              | ~27.5               | ~4.8%                 |
| 8        | Tesla                     | TSLA       | Consumer Discretionary   | ~$600B               | ~45.0               | ~2.5%                 |
| 9        | Broadcom                  | AVGO       | Semiconductors           | ~$650B               | ~50.0               | ~2.3%                 |
| 10       | Costco                    | COST       | Consumer Staples         | ~$380B               | ~52.0               | ~1.5%                 |

### **Key Notes:**
1. **Market Cap & P/E Ratios** are approximate and based on **Trailing Twelve Months (TTM)** as of **June 2024**.
2. **NVIDIA** has seen a massive surge in market cap due to AI demand, overtaking **Amazon** and **Alphabet** in weight.
3. **P/E Ratios** vary significantly:
   - **High P/E (NVDA, AMZN, TSLA, AVGO, COST)** → Growth stocks with high future expectations.
   - **Lower P/E (AAPL, META, GOOGL)** → More mature, cash-flow-generating companies.
4. **Alphabet (GOOGL & GOOG)** is counted separately in the index but represents the same company.
5. **Weightings** are approximate and change with stock price movements.

### **Sources for Verification:**
- [Nasdaq-100 Official Holdings](https://indexes.nasdaq.com/)
- [Yahoo Finance (Market Data)](https://finance.yahoo.com/)
- [Bloomberg Markets](https://www.bloomberg.com/markets)
